content:
**Escape Artist** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Running will no longer produce movement sounds, improving the ability to sneak. Entering sneak mode will temporarily provide a Stealth Field and break detection. This ability may be used once every 3 seconds.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Sneak to lose enemies, and running no longer affects stealth. | 003701B2 | 

 Prior to patch 1.1.2.9, gaining invisibility via the Chameleon mutation while already invisible due to the Escape Artist perk or vice versa would result in the player character gaining permanent invisibility.**[patched]**
